title_en: APARTMENT FOR SALE 2+1 + VERANDA + PARKING SPACE!

The apartment has a total area of ​​146.9 m2, of which 78 m2 of interior space, 13.8 m2 of common area and 55.1 of veranda area, is located on floor 0 (Zero).
